packed-reloc:

@g = global <{i8, ptr}> <{i8 1, ptr @a}>, align 8
negative-addend:

@g = global ptr getelementptr (i8, ptr @a, i64 -1)
large-addend:
@a = external global i8
@g = global ptr getelementptr (i8, ptr @a, i64 4294967296)
past-end:
@a = global i32 1
@g = global ptr getelementptr (i8, ptr @a, i64 5)
function-addend:
declare i32 @f()
@g = global ptr getelementptr (i8, ptr @f, i64 1)
integer-reloc:

@g = global i64 ptrtoint (ptr @a to i64)

define i32 @f() { ret i32 poison }
